content.text: Box 1 has started and I'm fighting the first fodder enemies. My plan is to get the kills right next to me so the debris piles up where I'm standing.
I got the first kill and its debris froze into a tall column just northeast of me. I'll keep making kills next to that column so the debris forms steps I can climb.
Three kills so far, but most of the debris flew off, so only a small 0.37 m block is left by the back wall. I'm still fighting and trying to stack the debris in one place.

detail: box 1: 3 kills, debris scattered; still fighting

content.text: Four kills now, HP 84. Debris is collecting along the west wall, so I'll try to knock enemies that way to build it up.
Still in box 1 with five kills and HP 76. The debris is spread out in small pieces, so I'm still trying to concentrate it in one spot.
I took a beating in the middle of the crowd (HP 52), so I dashed back to the south wall to keep all the enemies in front of me. Next I'll drop-kick them as they come in.
Nine kills. I'm now standing on a 0.54 m heap near the back wall around (2.3, 3.1), so I'll stay here and fight to build it up.
Ten kills, HP 36, and I'm in the northeast corner with enemies coming from the west. Kicking to stagger the closest one.
I've got 11 kills, HP 28, and I'm standing on a 0.4 m heap with about a dozen calls left. I'm holding this spot and kicking whatever comes close.
Six calls left and HP 20, so I'm spending the rest on drop-kicks.
